author: o2cord
message: Extended the jsDelivr fallback to profile theme, badges, nameplate, and USSRO2 registry fetches - not just the updater itself - so a rate-limited raw.githubusercontent.com no longer silently blanks out all custom content
notes: ussro2 backgrounds are loaded from backgrounds.json beside this manifest
ProfileTheme images are loaded from profile-themes.json beside this manifest
o2cord shared badges are loaded from badges.json beside this manifest
